steps.title: This is AdvantageScope
steps.say: AdvantageScope shows you what your robot is doing: every number it logs, graphed over time or drawn on the field. Let's look around.

steps.title: The field list
steps.say: Every value your robot publishes shows up here as a **field**, grouped into folders like `Drive/` or `Shooter/`. When nothing is connected it says **No data available**.

steps.title: Search
steps.say: Robots log a lot. Type part of a name here, like `RPM`, to find a field fast.

steps.title: Tabs
steps.say: Each tab is one way of looking at the data. You can have several line graphs, a 2D field, a 3D field, and more, all open at once.

steps.title: Open the line graph
steps.say: A line graph plots values over time. It's the first thing to reach for when you want to know "how fast was the flywheel going?"

steps.title: Left axis
steps.say: To plot something, **drag a field** from the list on the left and drop it here. It's drawn against the scale on the left side of the graph.

steps.title: Right axis
steps.say: Drop a field here instead to give it its own scale on the right. Handy when one value is in the thousands (RPM) and another is between -1 and 1 (motor output).

steps.title: Discrete fields
steps.say: True/false values and text, like `GamePieceLoaded`, go here. They show as colored stripes under the graph instead of lines.

steps.title: Axis options
steps.say: The **⋯** button on each list sets things like locking the axis range or applying a filter such as Differentiate (how fast a value is changing).

steps.title: Open the 2D field
steps.say: Now let's see where the robot is.

steps.title: Poses
steps.say: Drag a **pose** field (like `RobotPose2d`) here and the robot appears on the field, moving as it drives.

steps.title: Field settings
steps.say: Pick which year's field to draw, and flip it to match how you're looking at the real field.

steps.title: More kinds of tab
steps.say: The **+** button adds a tab: a 3D field, a table of raw values, the console, joysticks, and more. That's everything you need to start digging into your robot's data.
